import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for the keycloak/keycloak repository
    search_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search GitLab")
    await search_box.fill("keycloak/keycloak")
    await search_box.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 2: Click on the repository link in search results
    # Assuming the repository appears as a link with a name containing 'keycloak'
    repo_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="keycloak", exact=False)
    await repo_link.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 3: Navigate to the issues page of the repository
    # Look for an 'Issues' link in the repository navigation or sidebar
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=False)
    await issues_link.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 4: Apply filter for labels related to flaky-test
    # Try to find a button or element to filter by labels
    label_filter = page.get_by_role("button", name="Labels", exact=False)
    if await label_filter.count() > 0:
        await label_filter.first.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        label_search = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search labels", exact=False)
        if await label_search.count() > 0:
            await label_search.fill("flaky-test")
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            flaky_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="flaky-test", exact=False)
            if await flaky_option.count() > 0:
                await flaky_option.first.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 5: Retrieve and display the list of issues
    # Look for issue elements, commonly with role 'listitem' or within a list
    issues_container = page.get_by_role("list")
    if await issues_container.count() == 0:
        issues_container = page.get_by_role("grid")
    if await issues_container.count() > 0:
        issues = issues_container.get_by_role("listitem")
        if await issues.count() == 0:
            issues = issues_container.get_by_role("row")
        issues_count = await issues.count()
        for i in range(issues_count):
            issue = issues.nth(i)
            text = await issue.text_content()
            print(text)
    else:
        # Fallback: try to find any issue-like elements
        issue_elements = page.get_by_role("article")
        issues_count = await issue_elements.count()
        for i in range(issues_count):
            issue = issue_elements.nth(i)
            text = await issue.text_content()
            print(text)
